metadata.description: Modern, native-looking components, templates, theme styles and kits for Oracle APEX 23.1 to 26.x, packaged as an agent skill that works with Oracle's apexlang skill.

plugins.name: apex-modern-components
plugins.description: Create, port, install and use modern Oracle APEX components (template component plug-ins), native List and Region templates (incl. Living, navigation and authentication templates), Universal Theme styles with a WCAG contrast gate, and plugin-free Motion and Message kits. Emits APEXlang for APEX 26.1+ and 23.1 SQL exports; hands off to Oracle's apexlang skill for grammar, compiler and runtime validation.
